versions.changelog:
No changes detected in this version.

- Version bump to 1.0.1 with no file or documentation updates.
- No impact to API, features, or documentation.

Initial release of chitin-cert — on-chain certificate issuance and verification on Base L2.

- Issue, batch-issue, and verify 7 types of non-transferable NFT certificates, all stored permanently on Arweave.
- Register securely as an issuer and generate API keys with wallet signatures.
- Supports achievement, capability, compliance, audit, partnership, infrastructure, and custom cert types.
- Certificates can be soul-linked for deep identity binding.
- Provides webhooks for real-time cert minting notifications.
- Comprehensive API for issuing, querying, and verifying certificates.
